text:
maria_cs: Hey team — SageBank emailed back their bespoke SIG and flagged two blocking items: (1) clarification on our audit log retention (they want sample exports + retention policy language), and (2) KMS/HSM evidence showing key usage proofs and attestation timeline. They gave EOD Thursday for a response. Can we assemble a short repro + artifacts they can accept?

sam_security: I can own the KMS/HSM evidence. Need to confirm which attestation docs we can share for private deployments vs hosted. Also need a timeline for when the key IDs were rotated historically.

jason_support: For audit logs, we can provide a sanitized sample export and the retention TTL from the account (per-customer retention is 90 days by default, enterprise has options). Do we need to include raw PII-free entries or a summarized CSV?

olivia_engineer: For samples, we should give a few lines of actual formatted logs and a JSON schema for the audit record. Example snippet I can include (sanitized):
```
2026-03-15T14:22:03Z audit.event: key.access user="redwood-svc" key_id="proj-78-shard3" action="encrypt" result="success" request_id="req_8a2"
2026-03-15T14:23:10Z audit.event: auth.refresh user="svc-orbit" token_id="tok_42" action="rotate" result="success" request_id="req_8b9"
```
We should strip any customer identifiers, replace with placeholders.

lynne_sagebank: Thanks — sample logs like that are fine. For KMS, we specifically need proof that keys are backed by an HSM and dates for last attestation and rotations. Also please confirm exportability of audit logs to their SIEM.

sam_security: We can provide a formal attestation statement that Hosted Redwood uses HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2 level) for customer key material and list the last attestation date for our cloud KMS provider. For Dedicated/Private installs, we can provide guidance on on-prem HSM attestation docs customers should supply.

maria_cs: Quick coordination ask: can we get a short PDF attestation + a zipped sample log export by tomorrow EOD so I can forward to SageBank and ask for a 48h extension if needed?

olivia_engineer: I will generate a sanitized export and JSON schema today. Putting it in a shared folder and will post the link here.

sam_security: I'll draft a one-page attestation (non-legal) with dates: last cloud KMS attestation 2025-11-03, key rotation cadence documented, and an appendix describing HSM vendor and model. Legal may need to sign off if they want an official attestation.

compliance_bot: Reminder: any attestation referencing FIPS/HSM must be reviewed by Legal. Create an internal ticket at https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-ATT-241 to track sign-off.

jason_support: Filed CS-ATT-241 and added links to the sample logs and Olivia's schema. Also captured SageBank's required acceptance checklist in the ticket comments.

maria_cs: Perfect. Action items: Sam -> draft attestation + list of attestation dates. Olivia -> sanitized log export + schema (share link). Jason -> confirm log export format and zip. I'll request a 48h extension from SageBank once we have the artifacts. Thanks all :thumbsup:

lynne_sagebank: Appreciate the fast turnaround. If you can include a short note about retention policy enforcement (who configures it and default TTL), that'll help our compliance reviewers.

olivia_engineer: Note for the attestation: include the audit log retention doc snippet: "Default retention: 90 days. Enterprise customers can request retention extensions via support and contractual addendum."

sam_security: Adding that line to the draft. Expect initial attestation + links by EOD tomorrow.

maria_cs: I'll draft the extension request language to the customer: "We are preparing the requested artifacts and expect to deliver an attestation and sanitized audit log samples within 24 hours. Could you provide a 48-hour extension to review?" Will post once ready.

lynne_sagebank: Extension approved by SageBank compliance team — they confirmed via email. Thanks, everyone.

maria_cs: Closing loop here: moving artifacts to CS ticket and sending to Lynne. Will paste final message to SageBank in the ticket so we have copy.

(END)
